 Medvedev vs. Tiafoe: Nitto ATP Finals Preview & Betting Odds
 bet365 News Team
 Published: 5 hours ago
 A high-stakes clash awaits at the ATP Finals as Daniil Medvedev and Frances Tiafoe go head-to-head for a coveted spot in the semifinals.
 Match 
 Daniil Medvedev vs. Frances Tiafoe (Nitto ATP Finals Group Stage)
 Date 
 Friday, November 20, 2026
 Time 
 2:30 p.m. ET / 8:30 p.m. CET (Local Time)
 Venue 
 Inapli Arena
 Location 
 Turin, Italy
 TV Channel 
 Tennis Channel
 With Carlos Alcaraz already safely through to the knockout stages, this decisive showdown in the Ivan Lendl Group will determine who secures the second qualifying berth. Both Medvedev and Tiafoe enter the contest on equal footing, holding identical 1-1 win-loss records and an even 2-2 set tally in round-robin play.
 Their journeys at the tournament have mirrored each other closely: both recorded comfortable straight-sets victories over Flavio Cobolli, and neither could find an answer to Alcaraz, succumbing to the Spaniard in their respective matches.
 Head-to-Head: Form & Record
 While the stakes suggest a tightly contested affair, the broader statistics tip the scales in Medvedev’s favor. The Russian holds a 55-20 match record this season compared to Tiafoe's 44-21 mark. Medvedev has also enjoyed a more prolific campaign on the ATP Tour, capturing titles in Brisbane, Dubai, Hangzhou, and Almaty, while the American has collected one tournament victory, lifting the trophy in Halle.
 Medvedev also holds a commanding advantage in their head-to-head rivalry, having won six of their eight previous encounters.
 How to Watch Medvedev vs. Tiafoe
 Fans in the United States can watch the match between Daniil Medvedev and Frances Tiafoe on the Tennis Channel or it can be streamed live on YouTube TV, Fubo, or the Tennis Channel App.
